description:
Run TypeScript/JavaScript in a sandbox. Call tools as `await tools.<server>.<tool>({...})`. Use loops, filters and `console.log` freely; only the returned value and logs come back to you. The sandbox has no network, filesystem, timers beyond the deadline, or access to credentials. Return a compact result; large intermediate data should stay in the sandbox.
Write the body of an async function. Use `return` to send a value back.
Tools are at `tools.<server>.<tool>(args)` and return Promises. Call `describe` first for exact types.
Independent tool calls may run concurrently with Promise.all.
Errors from tools throw; catch them if you want to continue.

code.description: Body of an async function. Use `return` for the result.

name: execute
